ci_support_linux_64_.yaml:
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10

about.description:
Panoply is a cross-platform application for plotting geo-referenced
and other arrays from netCDF, HDF, GRIB, and related scientific data
formats. This package also installs command-line tools from netCDF-Java,
using the netCDF-Java uber-JAR distributed as part of the Panoply
release. This keeps the command-line tools aligned with the netCDF-Java
version, including any Panoply-specific fixes, shipped with Panoply.
about.summary: Panoply scientific data visualization application and bundled netCDF-Java command-line tools.

name: panoply
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: Panoply
  version: "5.10.2"

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://www.giss.nasa.gov/tools/panoply/download/PanoplyJ-${{ version }}.tgz
  sha256: a6b3bc0d2c86ae74112501d7c1bca73ce71911064e6463c69343272c2dae1cd8

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: generic

requirements:
  build:
    - dos2unix
  run:
    - openjdk >=11
    - menuinst >=2.2

tests:
  - script:
      - test -f $PREFIX/bin/panoply
      - test -f $PREFIX/bin/panoply.bat
      - test -f $PREFIX/bin/panoplycl
      - test -f $PREFIX/bin/panoplycl.bat
      - ncj-panoply-ncdump
      - ncj-panoply-nccopy
      - ncj-panoply-nccompare
      - ncj-panoply-bufrsplitter
      - ncj-panoply-cfpointwriter
      - ncj-panoply-gribcdmindex
      - ncj-panoply-featurescan
      - ncj-panoply-catalogcrawler

about:
  summary: Panoply scientific data visualization application and bundled netCDF-Java command-line tools.
  license: Unlicense
  license_file: README.txt
  homepage: https://www.giss.nasa.gov/tools/panoply/
  documentation: https://www.giss.nasa.gov/tools/panoply/help/
  description: |
    Panoply is a cross-platform application for plotting geo-referenced
    and other arrays from netCDF, HDF, GRIB, and related scientific data
    formats. This package also installs command-line tools from netCDF-Java,
    using the netCDF-Java uber-JAR distributed as part of the Panoply
    release. This keeps the command-line tools aligned with the netCDF-Java
    version, including any Panoply-specific fixes, shipped with Panoply.
    
extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - cofinoa
    - scharlton2
